name: baseUrl cannot contain userinfo query or fragment
operatorYaml:
lynxus:
  extensions:
    services:
      - registrationId: acme-channel-provider
        baseUrl: https://user:pass@acme-channel-provider:8080/lynxus?debug=true#fragment
        exposes:
          channelProviderTypes:
            - enterprise.acme.internal-im
        auth:
          type: INTERNAL_TOKEN
